descripcion:
Ticketmaster lawsuit: why is Ticketmaster being sued by the FTC? In September 2025 the FTC and seven states sued Live Nation and Ticketmaster. The FTC alleges that five ticket brokers (resellers who buy tickets to sell them again) controlled 6,345 Ticketmaster accounts and held 246,407 concert tickets to 2,594 events.

The same complaint alleges that from 2019 through 2024, consumers paid over $16.4 billion in mandatory fees on Ticketmaster purchases. Mandatory fees are the charges you cannot skip at checkout, on top of the ticket price.

Is this proven? No. These are allegations in a complaint, and the case is pending. This is not a class action you can join; it is a government lawsuit.

Source: FTC v. Live Nation and Ticketmaster, complaint 2:25-cv-08884 (C.D. Cal.), Sep 18, 2025, pages 17 and 42. Photo: Shixart1985, CC BY 2.0, Wikimedia Commons.
